glow-pink.note: Default of --accent; in the island it is replaced by the album colour (hsl, lightness 52-66%).

glow-purple.note: Second glow stop only (--glow2); follows album hue + 48deg.

display.purpose: Settings area title, one per view.

numeral.purpose: Timer ring, big stats, agenda day; always tabular.

title.purpose: Row labels; 12.5px in quick settings, 12px for launcher tile names.

body.purpose: Base text, pill text and header text.

hint.purpose: Row descriptions and group titles (600) in Ink 3.

label.purpose: Chips, small links, the +N atalhos line, dock labels.

shadows.name: lit-edge
shadows.purpose: The island's edge; light grows downward. Settings window uses 0.05 / 0.09 / 0.16.

shadows.name: inner-edge
shadows.purpose: Every flat block, the dock, the preview stage.

shadows.name: drag-lift
shadows.purpose: A row or dock item being reordered.

shadows.name: alarm-bloom
shadows.purpose: Peak of the timer-end pulse only.

shadows.name: ambient-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(closest-side at 24% 72%, var(--glow), transparent), radial-gradient(closest-side at 80% 86%, var(--glow2), transparent); filter: blur(26px); mask from 40% down; opacity calc(var(--glow-strength) * 0.62)
shadows.purpose: The low glow under the island's bottom edge; the preview stage uses blur 34px.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Main ease for movement: layers, toggles, dock label, area arrival.

motion.name: layer-in
motion.value: opacity/filter 0.3s ease 0.07s, transform 0.5s var(--ease) 0.05s; from blur(9px) scale(0.965)
motion.purpose: Island states enter with blur and scale.

motion.name: glow-drift
motion.purpose: Slow movement of the ambient glow.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Hover and state changes on controls.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on buttons, tiles and dock items.

motion.name: alarm
motion.purpose: Timer end; reduced motion keeps a static bloom.

components.css: .ds-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 110px); gap: 6px; padding: 12px; background: #000; } .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 62px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: none; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tile:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-tile:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ff5c7a); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tile.first { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.075); } .ds-tile.match { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #ff5c7a) 14%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #ff5c7a) 45%, transparent); } .ds-li { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 15px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-tile b { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; font: 600 12px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Button

narrative.overview:
Docky is a piece of pure black hung from the top edge of the screen, with a face. Everything else is borrowed from that object: the Settings window is the island's own world held to a working pace, near-black instead of black, with a rail one shade lifted from the ground. The character lives in two places only, the eyes and the glow; the rest is calm, flat and quiet so the character can be seen.

Surfaces are flat. Depth comes from tone (one step of white over black) and from a single lit edge whose light grows from top to bottom, as if the island caught the desk light under it. Options sit on hairlines, not in boxes. One accent colour marks whatever is active, and in the island that colour is not fixed: it is pulled from the album cover while music plays and falls back to the brand pink.

Density is compact and Windows-native in scale (13px body, 30 to 34px controls), with Inter throughout, tabular numerals for every clock, counter and timer, and sentence-case Portuguese labels.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black island, near-black settings window; no light theme.
Flat blocks one tone above black with a 1px inner edge.
One accent (default #FF5C7A, album-driven in the island) reserved for the active, selected, focused or primary thing.
Pink-to-purple glow kept low: behind the island's bottom edge and behind the Settings preview stage, nowhere else.
Rows on hairlines instead of boxed cards.
Motion with one long, soft-landing ease; everything has a reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The One Pink Rule
rules.body: The accent marks what is active, selected, focused or primary, and nothing else. If an element is pink and you cannot say which of those four it is, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Album Owns The Accent Rule
rules.body: Inside the island every accent use goes through `var(--accent, #ff5c7a)` so the cover colour can take over. Never hard-code the pink in island components.

rules.name: The Glow Stays Low Rule
rules.body: The pink-to-purple glow is a blurred, masked pair of radial gradients that rises from below: behind the island's bottom edge (opacity at most 0.62 × the user's glow strength) and behind the Settings preview stage. It never sits behind text blocks, rows or controls.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Every time, countdown, count and percentage uses tabular numerals so the island never jitters as numbers change.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, group titles and buttons are sentence case. Group titles are 12px 600 in Ink 3, not uppercase and not letter-spaced.

rules.name: The Header Is The Field Rule
rules.body: In the opened island the active page's input (search in Atalhos, quick note in Notas) lives in the header row, portalled into one slot; typing any letter focuses it. Pages do not add a second search or input row in the body.

rules.name: The Light Grows Downward Rule
rules.body: The island and the window share one edge: a 1px masked gradient, dim at the top, brightest at the bottom. This edge gradient is the world's own device and is allowed; gradient fills on blocks are not.

rules.name: The Flat Block Rule
rules.body: A block is one flat tone of white over black plus a 1px inner edge. No vertical glass gradients, no backdrop blur, no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do route every island accent through `var(--accent, #ff5c7a)` so the album colour takes over.
Do keep blocks flat: a 0.06 to 0.07 white fill and a 1px inner edge.
Do separate options with a 1px hairline at 0.07, not with boxes.
Do use the main ease `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` for movement and give every animation a `.reduce-motion` fallback.
Do use tabular numerals for times, counts and percentages.
Do keep hints and placeholders at Ink 3 (0.5) or stronger.
Do put the active page's input in the island header row.
donts: Don't use the accent for decoration; it marks active, selected, focused or primary only.
Don't put the glow anywhere except under the island's bottom edge and behind the Settings preview stage.
Don't fill blocks or tiles with vertical glass gradients or add backdrop blur.
Don't use uppercase, letter-spaced labels or kicker lines above titles; group titles are sentence case 12px Ink 3.
Don't add a light theme or grey boxed setting groups.
Don't use alarm red for anything except a timer ending.
